**Severity:** error · **Area:** Imports / helpers / route modules (`RV3xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
Declare server exports (serverLoad, onGet, …) in their own export statement
```

```text
`export *` is not allowed in a route module: server exports must be named
```

## How to fix

Give each server export (serverLoad, onGet, …) its own export statement and replace `export *` with named exports.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const serverLoad = () => 1, other = 2;
export default () => <p />;
```

```tsx prefer
export const serverLoad = () => 1;
export const other = 2;
export default () => <p />;
```

## When it is reported

serverExports option (route modules).
